segments.name: Americas
segments.description: Seating operations in North America and South America serving automotive OEM customers.
segments.evidence: Adient manages its business on a geographic basis and operates in the following three reportable segments for financial reporting purposes: 1) Americas, which is inclusive of North America and South America; 2) Europe, the Middle East and Africa ("EMEA") and 3) Asia Pacific/China ("Asia").

segments.name: EMEA
segments.description: Seating operations in Europe, the Middle East and Africa serving automotive OEM customers.
segments.evidence: Adient manages its business on a geographic basis and operates in the following three reportable segments for financial reporting purposes: 1) Americas, which is inclusive of North America and South America; 2) Europe, the Middle East and Africa ("EMEA") and 3) Asia Pacific/China ("Asia").

segments.name: Asia Pacific/China
segments.description: Seating operations in Asia Pacific and China serving automotive OEM customers, including domestic Chinese OEMs.
segments.evidence: Adient manages its business on a geographic basis and operates in the following three reportable segments for financial reporting purposes: 1) Americas, which is inclusive of North America and South America; 2) Europe, the Middle East and Africa ("EMEA") and 3) Asia Pacific/China ("Asia").

revenueModel.text: Global automotive OEMs pay Adient for complete seating systems and components for passenger cars, commercial vehicles and light trucks.
revenueModel.evidence: Adient is a supplier to all of the global OEMs and has longstanding relationships with premier automotive manufacturers, including BMW, Mercedes-Benz Group, Ford Motor Company, General Motors Company, Honda Motor Company, Hyundai Motor Company, Jaguar Land Rover, Kia Corporation, Mazda Motor Corporation, Mitsubishi Motor Corporation, Nissan Motor Corporation, Polaris Inc., Renault Group, Stellantis N.V., Suzuki Motor Corporation, Toyota Motor Corporation, Volkswagen Group, and Volvo Cars.
